required_agent_checks: Create separate forks: target advanced but retained notes still name the matching version; retained notes name a different version; and provenance is absent. Supply actual release version and explicit allowed effects/destination in current state. Do not let a copied prepared answer satisfy the test.

Observe the consumer inspecting local source/coverage/ancillary context and version before consumption. Matching version alone is insufficient; stale or unknown coverage is reconstructed/refreshed and the intended version is reconciled without inventing a bump.

Use a declared controlled boundary that stops before final provider publication and retain refreshed notes/source/body hash. Human content survives applicable refresh. No live provider success is inferred from a local marker or stopped request. Required refresh cannot be bypassed because notes exist.

matching-version: New source coverage is refreshed despite matching version.
version-mismatch: Notes identify the established version before consumption without an invented bump.
missing-provenance: Absent source context triggers coverage reconstruction, not assumption of freshness.
